issues.description: Problem statement for Aufgabe 01 asks for the names and internet addresses (url) of all Zoos and the name and regierungsbezirk of the respective Gemeinde, but the solution file only selects Zoo.name and Zoo.url and omits Gemeinde.name and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. The template also lacks the required join and the url/regierungsbezirk columns. This mismatch between the problem specification and the provided solution/template will confuse students about the expected output columns.
issues.suggestedFix: Update both the template and the solution for Aufgabe 01 to select exactly the four requested columns and include the join. For example: SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url AS Internetadresse, Gemeinde.name AS Gemeinde_name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo, Gemeinde WHERE Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel; Ensure the template contains the same column list and join (with a TODO if intended for students) so it matches the problem description.
